mechanism: Hydrocodone causes CNS and respiratory depression which may mask or worsen symptoms of ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity from gentamicin; both drugs can impair renal function and gentamicin levels may accumulate with opioid-induced reduced clearance.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, assess for ototoxic symptoms, use lowest effective hydrocodone dose, and consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
